mode: Two independent read-only source reviewers, followed by fix-specific re-review; not security certification or runtime execution

initialFindings.risk: Successful READY callback could be delivered after drain acknowledgement/new generation.
initialFindings.fix: Track notificationInFlight and cleanupComplete; wipe physical buffers first, defer active-slot release and drain until callbacks return.
initialFindings.reproduction: Regression failed before fix: Drain acknowledged before the in-flight READY notification returned.
initialFindings.verification: 224 pure JVM adapter assertions passed after fix, including cancel+dispose notification ordering.
initialFindings.review: Fixed; no additional evidence-backed defect in changed completion code.

initialFindings.risk: Old queued consume finally could stop a newer session observer.
initialFindings.fix: watchSession identity and generation/idle/synthetic guard under lifecycleLock; generated module synchronized.
initialFindings.verification: Independent source re-review confirms fix and generated parity; no Android module race runtime test yet.
initialFindings.review: Fixed at source level; no additional evidence-backed defect in requested fix.

caveats: Reserved READY callback may race cancel beginning, but cannot outlive drain acknowledgement; consume remains authoritative.

Parent separately exercised 12/12 actual Android synthetic-codec cases, OS HOME/resume after suite, force-stop/cold-start, and bounded storage observations; reviewers themselves performed source review only.
No total JVM/native zeroization, whole-process memory cap, zero telemetry, enrollment/PAD/recognition approval.
